We need to retrieve the results of the most recent match between two football teams. But the user didn't specify two teams. They just asked "who is playing in La Liga?" That might be interpreted as "which teams are currently playing in La Liga?" This is ambiguous. The user might want a list of teams currently in La Liga. But we only have a function to get the result of the most recent match between two teams. There's no function to get the list of teams. So we cannot answer directly. We can ask clarifying question: "Which two teams would you like the match result for?" Or we can interpret "who is playing in La Liga?" as "which teams are currently playing in La Liga?"
